quote: The following regulations pertain to the operation of vehicles within a roundabout: The operator of a vehicle who intends to exit a roundabout: Shall use the left lane to turn left or complete a U-turn.

activation.condition: A vehicle operator is within a roundabout and intends to exit by turning left or completing a U-turn.

obligation.description: Use the left lane to turn left or complete a U-turn.
obligation.source_clause: Shall use the left lane to turn left or complete a U-turn.

timing.description: The lane choice must be observed throughout the circulating movement to the actual exit.

judgment_calls_needed.note: Intent itself is not directly observed; the original exit route and context provide limited evidence.
Left lane is relative to the original mapped circulatory lane adjacency and travel direction.

parameter_refs.name: requested_circulating_lane
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: left or right circulating lane request; actual occupancy unverified

parameter_refs.name: roundabout_exit_path
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: left-turn or U-turn exit route; no legal numeric threshold
